title: LtxPlan
description: LTX v1.1 SessionPlan wire format (docs/LTX-SPECIFICATION.md section 4). A plan is either v2 (section 4.1, frozen imul31 planId) or v3 (section 4.4, strictly additive, SHA-256 planId). Derived from createPlan / upgradeConfig / upgradePlanToV3 in javascript/ltx/ltx-sdk.js and LtxPlan / LtxPlanV3 in typescript/ltx/src/types.ts. Unknown top-level fields are tolerated (legacy v1 fields such as txName survive upgradeConfig) but, like every field, they are covered by the planId hash. Golden planId vectors: spec/golden/plan-ids.json.

nodeId.description: Node identifier (e.g. "N0"). MUST NOT contain '|', the pair-delay key separator (section 3.7.2).

delay.description: One-way delay in seconds from HOST to this node (section 3.7.1).

segment.description: Segment template (section 3.4). Core types MUST be supported; SPEAK, REST, PAD, OPEN and RELAY are auxiliary types handled by the reference SDKs.

speaker.description: Presenting node id for an attributed TX/SPEAK segment (section 3.4.1).

relay.description: Optional LTX-RELAY transport configuration (section 4.1.1). The relay is never a node.

tls_fingerprint.description: Pre-agreed shared secret used to authenticate relay frames.

nodes.description: Exactly one HOST, first, with delay 0 (section 3.1).

planV2.title: LtxPlan v2
planV2.description: Section 4.1. v3 fields MUST NOT appear in a v2 plan (section 4.3): the frozen planId hash is insertion-order-sensitive.

planV3.title: LtxPlan v3
planV3.description: Section 4.4. A v2 plan with v: 3 and optional additive fields.

delays.description: Pair-wise one-way delays in seconds (section 3.7.2). Keys are two node ids joined by '|' in lexicographically sorted order; sort order is not expressible in JSON Schema and is checked by validatePlan().

streams.description: RESERVED (section 3.5). MUST be absent or empty.
